 Aston Villa 1-0 Fulham 
 For all Fulham's positivity, Aston Villa have had one of the better chances of the second half.
 Ian Maatsen can't get his effort on target.

 'No conviction' published at 21:23 GMT 21:23 GMT 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Fulham 
 Rob Green 
Former Premier League goalkeeper on Sky Sport 
 Shea Charles has his head is in his hands.
 You just think that Oscar Bobb chance is the one.
 [But] there's no conviction in his strike.
 55 16 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 62 mins 62 mins 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Fulham 
 Oscar Bobb dances into the area but his shot is blocked. It comes back to Shea Charles on the edge of the penalty box but he can't get his shot on target.
 65 29 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 60 mins 60 mins 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Fulham 
 "Come on Fulham" is the chant from the away supporters as their side win a corner.
 It's sent in by Oscar Bobb and only half cleared before coming back to the halfway line. Fulham retain possession, though.
 Stark contrast to the first 45 minutes, this.
 55 75 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Good goalkeeping' from Suzuki published at 21:20 GMT 21:20 GMT 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Fulham 
 Rob Green 
Former Premier League goalkeeper on Sky Sport 
 Good goalkeeping.
 It's commanding, it doesn't look spectacular, but there is a sigh of relief when Suzuki gets involved.
 128 14 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 21:19 GMT 21:19 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say 
 Arsenal fan here, Suzuki is world class, take it from a fan base that knows world class keepers when they see them. Could be a real difference maker and they don't miss Martinez and his antics.
 Billy, Essex 
 309 97 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 58 mins 58 mins 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Fulham 
 Antonee Robinson tries a looping ball into the box but it's good goalkeeping from Zion Suzuki as he comes out to claim. Commanding his area.
 96 6 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Fulham search for 'magical answer' published at 21:18 GMT 21:18 GMT 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Fulham 
 Rob Green 
Former Premier League goalkeeper on Sky Sport 
 They have the possession and the good opportunities, but [Fulham] don't score.
 They have been pushing and pushing, but they can't find that magical answer.
 77 23 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 21:15 GMT 21:15 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say 
 Fulham are pretty to watch but with zero end product, and susceptible defensively, especially against pace. I can see it, all fellow Fulham supporters can see it, pundits can see it, all neutral fans can see it. But Arbeloa can't. God help us. Relegation beckons.
 Christopher, Cheltenham 
 124 80 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 54 mins 54 mins 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Fulham 
 Fulham have been the better side so far in this second half.
 But they have not yet been rewarded with a goal. As has often been the way this season. They must start finding goals when they enjoy these positive periods.
 61 43 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:11 GMT 21:11 GMT 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Fulham 
 Rob Green 
Former Premier League goalkeeper on Sky Sport 
 Johan Manzami isn't quite as defensively minded, so Fulham might get some opportunities down their right hand side.
 54 89 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 50 mins 50 mins 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Fulham 
 Fulham have started this second half well but a couple of times they have been caught offside. Tidy that up they might get somewhere.
 54 49 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 48 mins 48 mins 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Fulham 
 Ooooh.
 Aston Villa are opened up and Alex Iwobi plays a little one-two with Antonee Robinson before the ball is squared across for Gonzalo Garcia but his effort is straight at the keeper.
 Image source, PA Media 
 65 67 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 21:08 GMT 21:08 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 How many more chances do Fulham want before scoring, similar to Wednesday against Palace, can't blame the manager for players not taking their chances.
 Paul 
 141 51 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 KICK-OFF published at 21:06 GMT 21:06 GMT 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Fulham 
 Anyway we're back under way at Villa Park.
 150 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:06 GMT 21:06 GMT 
 Bit of reaction from Palace, there.
 Is manager Pierre Sage in trouble? No Premier League managers have lost their job yet so far this season but it feels like there are currently a couple of contenders.
 41 25 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Difficult situation for Sage at Palace' published at 21:04 GMT 21:04 GMT 
 FT: Tottenham 2-0 Crystal Palace 
 Stephen Warnock 
MOTD pundit and former Liverpool defender 
 It was difficult for them today because Mateta gets sent off early on and suddenly you change the context of the game. But it doesn't look good at the moment for them, too many mistakes.
 It's not a case of downing tools, it's almost just a lack of confidence and understanding of what they're trying to do. It looks like a very difficult situation to come back from for the manager.
 To get out of it, you have to have internal meetings between you as a team and try and find solutions. There can't be any finger pointing in the dressing room, it's got to be an acceptance of what you're doing wrong or what you can do to improve and get better. And the quicker people admit to that, and work as a collective, the quicker you'll find solutions.

 Mostly because I'm annoyed I didn't think of it.
